description: ICY1 conservation profile across 46 Saccharomycetaceae orthologs, the conserved C-terminal element, and its amphipathic helical wheel
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
prof = pd.read_csv("ICY1_conservation_profile.csv")
plddt = np.load("out/plddt.npy")
seqs = json.load(open("out/icy1_orthologs.json"))
ICY1 = open("out/Q04329.fasta").read().split("\n")[1]

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13.5, 8.2))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 2, height_ratios=[1, 1, 1.1], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.25)

# A: conservation vs pLDDT along the sequence
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
ax.bar(prof.pos, prof.identity, color="#2c7fb8", width=0.9, label="identity to ScICY1 across 46 orthologs")
ax2 = ax.twinx()
ax2.plot(prof.pos, plddt, color="#d95f02", lw=1.6, label="pLDDT")
ax2.set_ylabel("pLDDT", color="#d95f02"); ax2.set_ylim(20, 100)
ax.axvspan(106, 127, color="#000", alpha=0.07)
ax.set_xlabel("ICY1 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("fraction identical"); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.05)
ax.set_title("The only conserved block of ICY1 is the C-terminal helix 106-127\n"
             "mean identity 0.77 there vs 0.41 elsewhere (Mann-Whitney p = 1.6e-9, Cliff's delta 0.80); "
             "Spearman(identity, pLDDT) = 0.55, p = 3.6e-11", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=8); ax2.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8)

# B: sequence logo of the conserved block, from the projected alignment
def sw_cols():
    return None
M = None
# rebuild projection matrix quickly from saved profile is not possible; recompute block occupancy from orthologs
block = ICY1[105:127]
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
ax.bar(np.arange(106, 128), prof.identity[105:127], color=["#b2182b" if v >= 0.95 else "#2c7fb8" for v in prof.identity[105:127]])
for i, (p, a) in enumerate(zip(range(106, 128), block)):
    ax.text(p, 0.02, a, ha="center", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold",
            color="white" if prof.identity[p-1] > 0.5 else "black")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.08); ax.set_xlim(105, 128.5)
ax.set_xticks(range(106, 128)); ax.set_xticklabels(range(106, 128), fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel("fraction identical")
ax.set_title("Conserved C-terminal element DKLTDLYANAAQQNYRLWLSSF (red = >= 95% identity across orthologs)\n"
             "invariant: A116, Y120, W123, L124; near-invariant: A113, N119, R121, Q117, L122", fontsize=10)

# C: hydrophobic moment and helical wheel of 106-123
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
hm = pd.read_csv("out/hydrophobic_moment.csv")
ax.plot(hm.start, hm.muH, color="#2c7fb8", lw=1.8)
ax.axhline(0.45, color="#b2182b", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax.text(2, 0.465, "amphipathic-helix band", fontsize=8, color="#b2182b")
ax.scatter([106], [hm.loc[hm.start == 106, "muH"].values[0]], s=60, color="#b2182b", zorder=5)
ax.annotate("106-123\nmuH = 0.481", (106, 0.481), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(-52, -34), fontsize=8, color="#b2182b")
ax.set_xlabel("start of 18-residue window"); ax.set_ylabel("hydrophobic moment (100 deg)")
ax.set_title("Hydrophobic-moment scan of ICY1", fontsize=10)

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1], projection="polar")
eis = dict(A=0.62, R=-2.53, N=-0.78, D=-0.90, C=0.29, Q=-0.85, E=-0.74, G=0.48, H=-0.40, I=1.38,
           L=1.06, K=-1.50, M=0.64, F=1.19, P=0.12, S=-0.18, T=-0.05, W=0.81, Y=0.26, V=1.08)
w = ICY1[105:123]
ang = np.deg2rad(100.0) * np.arange(len(w))
for k, (a, th) in enumerate(zip(w, ang)):
    col = "#b2182b" if eis[a] > 0.4 else ("#2166ac" if eis[a] < -0.5 else "#888888")
    ax.text(th, 0.82, a, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", color=col)
    ax.text(th, 1.02, str(106 + k), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=6, color="#555")
mx = (np.array([eis[a] for a in w]) * np.cos(ang)).sum() / len(w)
my = (np.array([eis[a] for a in w]) * np.sin(ang)).sum() / len(w)
ax.annotate("", xy=(np.arctan2(my, mx), 0.65), xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color="#b2182b", lw=2.2))
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.12); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xticks([]); ax.grid(False)
ax.set_title("Helical wheel 106-123\nred = hydrophobic face (L108, L112, Y120, L122, W123, L124)\narrow = hydrophobic moment", fontsize=9)
plt.show()
